CB stance.note: Held 3.50-3.75% on 29 Jul with THREE regional presidents voting for a hike - first triple split since Sep 2016. At Jackson Hole on 28 Aug new Chair Warsh called inflation 'concerning', said underlying trends have not 'meaningfully improved' and the Fed has 'work to do'; Hammack, who wants higher rates, said 'now is the time to act'. The major central bank leaning hardest toward a hike, with a live hike on the table - but has not actually hiked and Warsh withheld an explicit September signal, so 4.5 not 5.

Next meeting expectation.note: September 15-16 now a coin flip: CME FedWatch hike odds jumped to ~46-56% (from ~33-36%) after Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote. Direction of risk clearly up; a hold is still roughly as likely as a hike.

Expected rate change.note: Post-Warsh, September hike odds are ~50% and the next move is firmly up, not down; only the timing (Sep vs later in 2026) is unresolved.
